$comment: The connector-facing core tools. The harness defines them natively from this file (its tool list never changes) and the MCP gateway serves them; both read the same definitions. Descriptions are prompt text: changing them invalidates every session's prompt cache.

tools.name: tools_search
tools.description: Find tools of connectors (apps and services). Returns matching tools with their full JSON input schemas, plus any usage notes from the connector. Search before calling a tool you haven't seen a schema for in this conversation, and again when a connector's version (v=) changes.

query.description: What you want to do, or a tool name, e.g. "crop image" or "browser.download". Empty with app set: list all of that connector's tools.

tools.name: tools_call
tools.description: Run a connector tool found with tools_search. Arguments are validated against the tool's schema; a closed connector returns an error saying how to open it.

args.description: Arguments matching the tool's input schema.

tools.name: apps_launch
tools.description: Open an app that is not running, then wait until its tools are available.

tools.name: apps_focus
tools.description: Move yourself into an app: its chat pane opens with this conversation and you continue there.

app.description: Connector name of an open app.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Hand a task to a subagent: another agent harness (pi; claude: Claude Code; codex: Codex), the one you run on included. It works in this session's directory with its own tools plus the same connectors, its progress shows in this chat, and its final reply comes back as the result. The user is asked before it starts. model and effort are optional: without them it uses what the user chose for that harness, else its own defaults. Write the task so it stands alone; follow-up delegations to the same agent continue its conversation. Subagents can't delegate.

task.description: What to do, with the context it needs.

model.description: Model for this task, as that harness names it (e.g. sonnet for claude). Default: the user's choice or the harness's own.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this task, as that harness names it (e.g. low, medium, high). Default: the user's choice or the harness's own.
